subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue be closed by a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb, or should closure require the broader live-target proof and optional switch-feedback controls described in the discussion?
rationale: Current main clearly lacks workspace header context and the linked PR covers the focused breadcrumb, but the issue discussion expands the safety contract in a way automation should not silently scope up or down.

options.title: Accept Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session-generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Closure Bar
options.body: Keep this issue open until the implementation proves the fuller live target tuple and switch feedback in the Dashboard.

options.title: Reject Header Expansion
options.body: Keep the current agent breadcrumb, /agent, /status, and workspace rail workflow as the supported path and close the linked PR separately by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session-generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent header context that this decision would extend or constrain.
